current_grouping: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations
versions.text:
Unless otherwise specified, compliance with the requirements of CS 25J1181 through CS 25J1203 must be shown by a full scale test or by one or more of the following methods:
(a) Tests of similar APU installations.
(b) Tests of components.
(c) Service experience of aircraft with similar APU installations.
(d) Analysis unless tests are specifically required.
